policy.evaluation: Meaning and context, not exact-string or keyword matching. These are editorial specifications, not an executable classifier.
policy.asrUncertain: Ask for repetition or editable text; do not assign a care error from uncertain recognition.
policy.priority: Unsafe action requires correction regardless of language fluency. Missing meaning permits clarification; no automatic next NPC turn.
policy.accepted: Both authored model and independent alternative may satisfy criteria; partial answer needs only missing meaning.
policy.scope: No diagnosis, medication advice, physical transfer instructions or unconstrained new facts.
policy.feedback: State achieved meaning, one missing/unsafe point, give the authored hint and retry.
